ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low overall ratio; surface is dominated by low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with high-intensity (white/tan) pixels occupying less than 5% of the total fluke area, primarily at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark pigmentation across both lobes. High-contrast tan/white clusters are localized at the distal tips. A single high-contrast white annulus (ring) is located in the upper-mid region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated as a narrow V-shaped depression with an approximate interior angle of 42 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of 1.2:1 relative to the immediate lobe transition.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular topography. The left lobe exhibits a significant large-scale indentation (negative amplitude deviation) approximately midway along the trailing edge. High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations are present across the remaining boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the median notch to the distal tips, interrupted on the left side by a significant traumatic excision.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, irregular, roughly circular pixel blobs (tan/white) are densely packed on the terminal ends of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, short, discontinuous linear white pixel markers are visible on the medial region of the right lobe and the upper region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant traumatic excision (notch) on the trailing edge of the left lobe. Distinct circular ring-shaped white scar on the left lobe surface. Extensive barnacle colonization clusters on the distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: The 'O' shaped circular white scar on the left lobe is a highly unique visual marker.
